# Vedsal B
> Personal website of Vedsal B featuring projects, writing, experience, and contact information.

A portfolio-style site presenting software engineering work, selected projects, background, and ways to connect.

## Main
- [Home](https://vedsalb.com/): Landing page introducing Vedsal B and highlighting core work and interests.
- [About](https://vedsalb.com/about): Background, interests, and personal profile information.
- [Projects](https://vedsalb.com/projects): Overview of selected software, research, and technical projects.
- [Experience](https://vedsalb.com/experience): Professional and academic experience summary.
- [Contact](https://vedsalb.com/contact): Contact details and ways to reach Vedsal B.

## Writing
- [Blog](https://vedsalb.com/blog): Index of published posts, essays, and technical writing.
- [Writing](https://vedsalb.com/writing): Collection of articles and longer-form written content.
- [Notes](https://vedsalb.com/notes): Short-form notes, ideas, or lightweight technical observations.

## Projects
- [Projects Index](https://vedsalb.com/projects): Central listing of featured projects and experiments.
- [Project Details](https://vedsalb.com/projects/): Project pages with descriptions, goals, and implementation details.
- [Open Source](https://vedsalb.com/open-source): Open-source contributions and publicly available code work.

## Professional
- [Resume](https://vedsalb.com/resume): Resume or CV with education, skills, and experience.
- [Experience](https://vedsalb.com/experience): Roles, responsibilities, and timeline of professional work.
- [Education](https://vedsalb.com/education): Academic background, institutions, and study history.
- [Skills](https://vedsalb.com/skills): Technical skills, tools, and areas of expertise.

## Research and Technical Work
- [Research](https://vedsalb.com/research): Research interests, publications, or ongoing technical investigations.
- [Publications](https://vedsalb.com/publications): Published papers, articles, or formal written outputs.
- [Talks](https://vedsalb.com/talks): Presentations, speaking engagements, or recorded talks.

## Contact and Profiles
- [Contact](https://vedsalb.com/contact): Direct contact page with communication options.
- [Links](https://vedsalb.com/links): Consolidated external profiles and important destinations.
- [Now](https://vedsalb.com/now): Current focus, active work, and recent priorities.

## Miscellaneous
- [Uses](https://vedsalb.com/uses): Hardware, software, and tools used for work and development.
- [Bookmarks](https://vedsalb.com/bookmarks): Saved references, recommended resources, or curated links.
- [Archive](https://vedsalb.com/archive): Archived posts, older work, or historical site content.
